content.comment_body: After transferring a program from [product_name] [article_no] with [product_name] TD to a PC using [product_name] V8.1 (Linux), the text and parameters from the right side of the message area are missing, and ticking attributes are not preserved. By adjusting the text block settings for the updated feature set, manual correction of texts and parameters is possible, after which the text blocks can be transferred both ways with integrity maintained. Is there a way to back up the original program without losing any texts, parameters, or ticking settings? I tested this with V7.0 (Windows) as well, with the same outcome.

analysis.insight_summary: A user describes losing text, parameters, and ticking settings on the right half of the message area when transferring a program from [product_name] [article_no] with [product_name] TD to a PC using [product_name] V8.1 on Linux. The same issue occurs with V7.0 on Windows. Although manual correction allows for intact re-transfer, the user is seeking a dependable backup approach that preserves all details during transfer.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to back up and transfer programs—including all related text blocks, parameters, and ticking states—flawlessly to a PC using [product_name], without encountering loss of data.
